host.description: The host that originated the Splunk event.  This data is present on all Splunk events, but may not be available in searches that use grouping (stats, timechart, etc.).  Grouped searches may include host, but often do not.

cloudIdentity.description: The structured data (pod, function, etc.) that is available when host is supplied.  This field is populated when host data is present in results.

exceptionClass.description:
The exception class
Search sample:  "search Exception level="ERROR" | rex "(?<exceptionClass>\S*Exception):" | stats count as e_count by exceptionClass | sort - e_count"

errorMessage.description:
The error message of the exception
Search sample:  "search Exception | rex "Exception: (?<errorMessage>.*)" | stats count as e_count by errorMessage | sort - e_count"

e_count.description:
The count of exception event logs
Search sample:  "search Exception level="ERROR" host="prod-*" | rex "(?<exceptionClass>\S*Exception):" | rex "Exception: (?<errorMessage>.*)" | stats count as e_count by exceptionClass, errorMessage | sort - e_count"

title:
Data available in Splunk searches that group "exception" log events. Specifically, Search (most likely) starts with "search Exception ...".
Note that any particular result row is expected to be populated with only subset of fields, based on the fields in search.
name: SplunkSearchResultExceptionRow
